title: param

messages.description: inform DAW about change state (0 = reading, 1 = writing)

arguments.description: 1 enables automatically handling change state when interacting with GUI objects

methods.description: creates the parameter, optionally with a default value, minimum and maximum
sets parameter mode: 1 for float, 2 integer, 3 logarithmic, 4 exponential

body: [param] sends and receives automation parameters to the DAW. You'll have to create an automation parameter in the sidebar.
